questions.question: If a + b + c = 10 and a² + b² + c² = 48, then the value of ab + bc + ca is _______.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

a + b + c = 10 and a2 + b2 + c2 = 4

**Concept Used:**

(a + b + c)² = a2 + b2 + c2 + 2ab + 2bc + 2ca 

**Calculation:**

⇒ Using the formula (a + b + c)2 we get,

⇒ (a + b + c)2 = a2 + b2 + c2 + 2ab + 2bc + 2ca 

⇒ (10)2 = 48+ 2(ab + bc + ca)

⇒ 100 – 48 = 2(ab + bc + ca)

⇒ ab + bc + ca = (52)/(2) = 26

**Therefore, the value of ab + bc + ca is 26.**

questions.question: If a + b = sqrt7 and a - b = sqrt5, then find value of 8ab (a² + b²) - (a - b)².
questions.solution:
**GIVEN:**

(a + b) = √7 

(a - b) = √5 

**FORMULA USED:**

(a - b)2 = a2 + b2 - 2ab

(a + b)2 = a2 + b2 + 2ab

 

**CALCULATION:**

⇒ a + b = √7 

Squaring both sides of the equation:

⇒ (a + b)² = 7

⇒ a² + b² + 2ab = 7 ------ (1)

Now,

⇒ a - b = √5 

Squaring both sides of the equation:

⇒ (a - b)2 = 5 

⇒ a2 + b2 - 2ab = 5 ------ (2)

On adding (1) and (2) we get,

⇒ 2 × (a² + b²) = 12

⇒ (a2 + b2) = 6 ------ (3)

Putting the value of equation (3) in equation (1)

⇒ a2 + b2 + 2ab = 7

⇒ ab = 1/2

Putting the required value in the equation:

8ab × (a2 + b2) - (a - b)2

⇒ ( 8 × 1/2 × 6 ) - (√5)² 

⇒ ( 24 - 5) = 19.

**∴ The required value is 19.**

questions.question: If p³ + 3p² + 3p = 26, then the value of p² + 2p is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

p³ + 3p² + 3p = 26 

**Formula used:**

( a + b)³ = a³ +b³ + 3ab ( a + b) 

**Calculation:**

p3 + 3p2 + 3p = 26 

Now add 1 to both the sides 

p3 + 3p2 + 3p + 1 = 26 + 1

This equation can be written as 

⇒ p³ + 1³ + 3p × 1 × (p + 1) = 27 

⇒(p + 1)³ = 3³

⇒ ( p +1) = 3 

⇒ p = 2

Now , p² + 2p = ( 2² + 2 × 2 ) = 8

**∴ The value is 8.**

If x⁸ – 2599x⁴ + 1 = 0, then the positive value of x-(1)/(x) will be:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

x8 – 2599x4 + 1 = 0

**Formula used:**

(a + b)² = a² + b² + 2ab

(a – b)² = a² + b² – 2ab

**Calculation:**

x8 – 2599x4 + 1 = 0

Dividing the equation by x⁴ we get,

⇒ x⁴ – 2599 + 1/x⁴ = 0

⇒ x⁴ + 1/x⁴ = 2599

As we know,

(x² + 1/x²)² = x⁴ + 1/x⁴ + 2 × x² × 1/x²

⇒ (x2 + 1/x2)2 = x4 + 1/x4 + 2

⇒ (x2 + 1/x2)² = 2599 + 2

⇒ (x2 + 1/x2)² = 2601

⇒ x² + 1/x² = √2601

⇒ x² + 1/x² = 51

Again as we know,

(x – 1/x)² = x² + 1/x² – 2 × x × 1/x

⇒ (x – 1/x)2 = x2 + 1/x2 – 2

⇒ (x – 1/x)² = 51 – 2

⇒ (x – 1/x)² = 49

⇒ (x – 1/x) = √49

⇒ x – 1/x = 7

**∴ The required value is 7**
